answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM data
SELECT ROUND(SUM("Profit"), 2) AS total_profit FROM data
SELECT "Country", ROUND(SUM("Profit"), 2) AS total_profit FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_profit DESC, "Country" LIMIT 1
SELECT "Year", ROUND(SUM("Sales"), 2) AS total_sales FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Year"
SELECT COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM data
SELECT COUNT(*) AS blocked_incidents FROM data WHERE "Action" = 'Blocked'
SELECT "Severity", COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT "Source", ROUND(SUM("Transaction Size (KB)"), 2) AS total_size_kb FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_size_kb DESC, "Source" LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) AS unique_employees FROM data
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_payroll_employees FROM employees e LEFT JOIN payroll p ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id WHERE p.employee_id IS NULL
SELECT SUM(gross_pay) AS total_gross_pay FROM data
